changelog:
smartlib-citation-checker 3.6.3

- Updated production gateway endpoint to SmartLib Gateway v52.1.
- Quota API fields expanded: now includes download_quota_free, download_reset_at, download_paid_remain, and download_remain.
- Adjusted low-quota prompts: users are now instructed to say "我要升级" to view packages, with details managed entirely through global-biblio-base's unified wallet (see its account documentation).
- Unified payment, quota, and upgrade management: all handled by global-biblio-base (smartlib-account); removed separate payment steps from this skill.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
